title: What your team gets
subtitle: NQ research for your existing trading process
intro: Real-time intraday NQ targets, a secure dashboard with statistics around those targets, and a daily target report by email. Built for professional NQ desks, research teams, and trading leadership evaluating the target record alongside their existing process.

offer.title: Real-time intraday targets
offer.body: Follow NQ target prices, direction, source timestamps, and current status in Today's Targets. The dashboard checks for updates every 60 seconds. Targets are published when qualifying conditions are met.

offer.title: Daily target statistics and an emailed report
offer.body: Review target counts, reached and unreached outcomes, timing, and session context in the dashboard. Receive a completed-session daily target report by email after the trading session.

offer.title: Weekly target statistics
offer.body: Compare target counts, outcomes, and resolution timing across the week. Inspect sample sizes, partial periods, and missing information. Weekly statistics help you evaluate more than one session; they do not establish future reliability.

delivery: Review daily and weekly target statistics and historical and rolling analysis in your dashboard, within your licensed history. Daily email includes one verified recipient per licensed seat, with an individual opt-out. Desk Intelligence and Firm-Wide Enterprise add a read-only daily, weekly, and history API and daily stats webhooks. Seat counts, history, and integration limits are shown on the next page.
sampleTitle: Evaluate a historical daily report sample
sampleText: Preview reached and unreached target records on the website. Request the October 12, 2026 daily report sample to inspect all nine targets. Delivery follows work-email confirmation and review. The sample illustrates a daily report; subscriptions include ongoing dashboard access. One session does not establish typical results.
boundary: Target outcomes are not customer trading returns. Harper Vance does not place orders, monitor your firm's trades, or provide personalized investment advice. Your team retains every trading decision.
purchaseTitle: Choose the access your team needs
purchaseIntro: The core research is the same. License differences cover users, history, integrations, and internal-use rights. Prices and scope are confirmed in the applicable agreement and order before payment.

steps.title: 1. Request access
steps.body: Choose a license, submit the business application, and confirm your work email. Requests are reviewed for qualification and available capacity. Applying does not collect payment or activate access.

steps.title: 2. Review the agreement and billing terms
steps.body: Approved customers review the applicable agreement and order, including billing interval, taxes, renewal, cancellation, and usage restrictions. Standard licenses use approved hosted checkout. Enterprise uses an agreed contract-managed billing process.

steps.title: 3. Complete payment and onboarding
steps.body: Access follows verified payment and the required organization and user setup. A request, payment-page redirect, or sample download alone does not activate the service. Confirm your access arrangements before relying on the service.

terms: Your applicable license and Order Form define usage rights, retention, seats, and service commitments. Review those terms during qualification. Target outcomes do not represent your desk's trading returns.
